keygen_title.description: Header title and accessible name of the key generation slide-over page.

keygen_error_name_required.description: Validation error on the identity step when the name field is empty.

keygen_error_expiry_required.description: Validation error on the custom expiry step when no calendar date is picked.

keygen_error_expiry_past.message: Expiry date must be in the future.
keygen_error_expiry_past.description: Validation error on the custom expiry step when the picked date is not after today.

keygen_error_generation_failed.description: Fallback error shown on the protection step when key generation throws without a message.

keygen_create_heading.description: Big heading on the first (identity) step of key generation.

keygen_create_subtitle_crx.message: A new RSA-2048 signing key for packaging a Chrome extension (.crx).
keygen_create_subtitle_crx.description: Subtitle under the heading when the CRX (Chrome extension signing) key type is selected. RSA-2048 and .crx stay as is.

keygen_create_subtitle_pgp.message: A new OpenPGP keypair for encrypting, decrypting, and signing messages.
keygen_create_subtitle_pgp.description: Subtitle under the heading when the PGP (messaging) key type is selected.

keygen_type_pgp.description: Toggle button label choosing the PGP key type. Sits side by side with keygen_type_crx in a narrow side panel; keep short.

keygen_type_crx.description: Toggle button label choosing the Chrome extension signing key type. Sits side by side with keygen_type_pgp; keep short.

keygen_label_label.description: Field label for the optional display label of a CRX signing key.

keygen_optional.description: Small muted tag after a field label meaning the field may be left blank (lowercase in English).

keygen_label_placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the CRX key label field; an example name.

keygen_name_label.description: Field label for the key owner's name; the asterisk marks it required.

keygen_name_placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the name field of key generation.

keygen_email_label.description: Field label for the optional email address in the key's user ID.

keygen_email_placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the email field; an example address.

keygen_comment_label.description: Field label for the optional OpenPGP user ID comment.

keygen_comment_placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the comment field; example comments.

keygen_advanced_options.description: Toggle that reveals algorithm, key size and expiry settings.

keygen_algorithm_label.description: Field label above the key algorithm dropdown (ECC / RSA).

keygen_algorithm_hint_ecc.message: Modern, fast, small keys. Recommended for most uses.
keygen_algorithm_hint_ecc.description: Tiny hint under the algorithm dropdown when ECC (Ed25519) is selected.

keygen_algorithm_hint_rsa.description: Tiny hint under the algorithm dropdown when RSA is selected.

keygen_key_size_label.description: Field label above the RSA key size dropdown.

keygen_key_size_4096.description: The only RSA key size option in the key size dropdown.

keygen_expiry_label.description: Field label above the key expiry dropdown.

keygen_expiry_never.description: Expiry dropdown option: the key never expires.

keygen_expiry_1y.description: Expiry dropdown option: expires one year from now.

keygen_expiry_2y.description: Expiry dropdown option: expires two years from now (the default).

keygen_expiry_3y.description: Expiry dropdown option: expires three years from now.

keygen_expiry_custom.description: Expiry dropdown option: pick a specific date on a calendar.

keygen_next.description: Full-width button advancing to the next key generation step.

keygen_expiry_heading.description: Big heading on the custom expiry calendar step.

keygen_expiry_subtitle.message: After this date the key can no longer be used; you can always generate a new one.
keygen_expiry_subtitle.description: Subtitle under the expiry heading explaining what expiry means.

keygen_expires_on.description: Line under the calendar once a date is picked. $date$ is a localised long date.

keygen_protect_heading.description: Big heading on the protection method step.

keygen_protect_subtitle.message: Choose how to unlock this key when you use it.

keygen_submit_use_passkey.description: Submit button on the protection step when reusing the passkey already set up for the vault. Half-width button; keep short.

keygen_submit_create_passkey.description: Submit button on the protection step that registers a new passkey. Half-width button; keep short.

keygen_submit_generate.description: Submit button on the protection step when protecting with a password. Half-width button; keep short.

keygen_generating_passkey.description: Spinner text while the browser's passkey (WebAuthn) dialog is open.

keygen_generating_key.description: Spinner text while the key is being generated with a password.

keygen_generating_rsa_hint.message: RSA keys take a moment to generate
keygen_generating_rsa_hint.description: Small note under the spinner for RSA / CRX keys, which are slow to generate.

keygen_protection_intro.message: Choose how to protect your private key:
keygen_protection_intro.description: Muted line above the passkey / password radio cards.

keygen_protection_passkey.description: Title of the passkey radio card.

keygen_protection_recommended.description: Small tag on the right of the passkey card title.

keygen_protection_passkey_desc.message: Use your fingerprint, face, or security key. No password to remember.
keygen_protection_passkey_desc.description: Description under the passkey card title.

keygen_protection_passkey_unavailable.description: Red note in the passkey card when the browser lacks WebAuthn PRF support; the card is disabled.

keygen_protection_reuse_passkey.message: Use the same passkey I already set up
keygen_protection_reuse_passkey.description: Checkbox label in the passkey card offering to reuse the vault's existing passkey instead of registering a new one.

keygen_protection_password.description: Title of the password radio card; also the accessible name of the password field.

keygen_protection_password_desc.message: Protect with a password. You'll enter it each time you unlock.
keygen_protection_password_desc.description: Description under the password card title.

keygen_password_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the new key password field; 8 is the enforced minimum.

keygen_confirm_password.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the repeat-password field.

keygen_error_password_short.message: Password must be at least 8 characters.
keygen_error_password_short.description: Validation error when the new key password is under 8 characters.

keygen_error_password_mismatch.description: Validation error when the two password fields differ.

keygen_key_password_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the field asking for an existing key's password to unlock it.

keygen_error_wrong_password.description: Error under a key's unlock field when the entered password does not open it.

keygen_error_passkey_failed.description: Error under a key's unlock control when the passkey ceremony fails (not when the user cancels).

keygen_error_key_not_unlocked.description: Error on the export private key page when the key's session handle has gone (key re-locked).

keygen_error_passphrase_short.message: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
keygen_error_passphrase_short.description: Validation error when the export passphrase is under 8 characters.

keygen_error_passphrase_mismatch.description: Validation error when the two export passphrase fields differ.

keygen_export_failed.description: Generic error when building or downloading the export fails without a message.

keygen_export_failed_detail.description: Error when building the export bundle throws. $message$ is the underlying error text (may be English).

keygen_export_toast_exported_one.description: Success toast after a passphrase-protected export. $count$ is the number of keys written.

keygen_export_toast_exported_other.description: Success toast after a passphrase-protected export. $count$ is the number of keys written.

keygen_export_toast_exported_unsafe_one.description: Success toast after a plaintext export. $count$ is the number of keys written. UNENCRYPTED is deliberately shouted.

keygen_export_toast_exported_unsafe_othe.description: Success toast after a plaintext export. $count$ is the number of keys written. UNENCRYPTED is deliberately shouted.

keygen_export_title.description: Default header title of the bulk key export page.

keygen_export_unlock_intro.message: Exporting a private key requires unlocking it first. Unlock the keys below to include them in the backup.
keygen_export_unlock_intro.description: Muted intro on the unlock step of bulk export, above the list of keys to unlock.

keygen_export_contacts_included_one.message: $count$ contact will also be included (public keys, no unlock needed).
keygen_export_contacts_included_one.description: Note on the unlock step of bulk export. $count$ is the number of contacts whose public keys go in the file.

keygen_export_contacts_included_other.message: $count$ contacts will also be included (public keys, no unlock needed).
keygen_export_contacts_included_other.description: Note on the unlock step of bulk export. $count$ is the number of contacts whose public keys go in the file.

keygen_export_skip_locked.description: Button on the unlock step that proceeds to export without the still-locked keys.

keygen_export_crx_included_one.message: Plus $count$ CRX signing key, re-encrypted under this passphrase so they restore on any device.
keygen_export_crx_included_one.description: Export step note when CRX (Chrome extension) signing keys are unlocked. $count$ is how many.

keygen_export_crx_included_other.message: Plus $count$ CRX signing keys, re-encrypted under this passphrase so they restore on any device.
keygen_export_crx_included_other.description: Export step note when CRX (Chrome extension) signing keys are unlocked. $count$ is how many.

keygen_export_still_locked_one.message: $count$ key still locked and will be left out.
keygen_export_still_locked_one.description: Amber warning on the export step. $count$ is the number of keys left locked. Followed by a space, the keygen_export_go_back_unlock link, then keygen_export_still_locked_after.

keygen_export_still_locked_other.message: $count$ keys still locked and will be left out.
keygen_export_still_locked_other.description: Amber warning on the export step. $count$ is the number of keys left locked. Followed by a space, the keygen_export_go_back_unlock link, then keygen_export_still_locked_after.

keygen_export_go_back_unlock.description: Underlined inline link in the still-locked warning that returns to the unlock step. Read as a sentence with keygen_export_still_locked_after: 'Go back to unlock.'

keygen_export_still_locked_after.description: Punctuation directly after the keygen_export_go_back_unlock link, closing that sentence. May be empty if your language needs no closing mark.

keygen_export_passphrase_intro.message: Set a passphrase to encrypt the exported private keys (OpenPGP S2K -- imports into GnuPG and other tools). Anyone with this passphrase and the file can decrypt your messages and sign as you.
keygen_export_passphrase_intro.description: Muted explanation above the passphrase fields on the export step. 'OpenPGP S2K' and 'GnuPG' are technical names; keep.

keygen_passphrase_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the export passphrase field; 8 is the enforced minimum.

keygen_confirm_passphrase_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the repeat-passphrase field on export.

keygen_exporting.description: Export button text while the bundle is being built.

keygen_export_with_passphrase.description: Primary button that exports private keys encrypted under the passphrase (bulk export and single PGP key export).

keygen_export_plaintext_warning_file.message: Plaintext export. Anyone who reads the downloaded file gets full control of every PGP key in it.
keygen_export_plaintext_warning_file.description: Red warning above the type-to-confirm field for an unencrypted bulk export. Followed by keygen_export_plaintext_crx_left_out (when CRX keys exist) and then the 'Type EXPORT to confirm:' fragments.

keygen_export_plaintext_crx_left_out.message: CRX signing keys are left out of a plaintext export -- use a passphrase to include them.
keygen_export_plaintext_crx_left_out.description: Extra sentence appended to the plaintext warning when CRX signing keys exist; they are never written unencrypted.

keygen_type_to_confirm_before.description: Fragment before the bold confirmation word (keygen_confirm_word). Read together: 'Type EXPORT to confirm:'

keygen_confirm_word.description: The word the user must type exactly to allow an unencrypted export. Shown in bold and as the field placeholder, and compared against the input; keep it a single uppercase word.

keygen_type_to_confirm_after.description: Fragment after the bold confirmation word (keygen_confirm_word). Read together: 'Type EXPORT to confirm:'

keygen_export_without_passphrase.description: Red button that exports private keys unencrypted (bulk export and single PGP key export).

keygen_export.description: Primary button on the export step when only public keys (contacts) are being exported, so no passphrase is needed.

keygen_export_nothing.description: Muted line on the export step when there are no unlocked keys and no contacts.

keygen_copied_encrypted.description: Green feedback after copying a passphrase-encrypted private key to the clipboard; the clipboard is wiped after 60 seconds.

keygen_copied_plaintext.description: Green feedback after copying an unencrypted private key to the clipboard; the clipboard is wiped after 30 seconds.

keygen_unlock_gate_passkey.message: Authenticate with your passkey to copy this key.
keygen_unlock_gate_passkey.description: Default intro on the unlock gate of the copy-private-key page for a passkey-protected key.

keygen_unlock_gate_password.message: Enter the key password to copy this key.
keygen_unlock_gate_password.description: Default intro on the unlock gate of the copy-private-key page for a password-protected key.

keygen_unlocking.description: Unlock button text while the key is being unlocked.

keygen_encrypting.description: Copy/export button text while the private key is being encrypted under the passphrase.

keygen_exporter_pgp_title.description: Header title of the page that copies a PGP private key to the clipboard.

keygen_exporter_pgp_encrypted_blurb.message: Set a passphrase to encrypt the exported key. Anyone with this passphrase and the exported key can decrypt your messages and sign as you.
keygen_exporter_pgp_encrypted_blurb.description: Muted explanation above the passphrase fields when copying a PGP private key.

keygen_exporter_pgp_plaintext_blurb.message: Plaintext export. Anyone who reads your clipboard gets full control of this key.
keygen_exporter_pgp_plaintext_blurb.description: Red warning above the type-to-confirm field when copying a PGP private key unencrypted. Followed by 'Type EXPORT to confirm:'.

keygen_exporter_crx_title.description: Header title of the page that copies a CRX (Chrome extension) signing key to the clipboard.

keygen_exporter_crx_unlock_passkey.message: Unlock this signing key to copy it. Authenticate with your passkey.
keygen_exporter_crx_unlock_passkey.description: Intro on the unlock gate when copying a passkey-protected CRX signing key.

keygen_exporter_crx_unlock_password.message: Unlock this signing key to copy it. Enter the key password.
keygen_exporter_crx_unlock_password.description: Intro on the unlock gate when copying a password-protected CRX signing key.

keygen_exporter_crx_encrypted_blurb.message: Set a passphrase to encrypt the copied key (re-importable into PGP Tools via Import Keys). Anyone with this passphrase and the copied block can sign extensions as you.
keygen_exporter_crx_encrypted_blurb.description: Muted explanation above the passphrase fields when copying a CRX signing key. 'PGP Tools' is the product name; 'Import Keys' is the name of the import page.

keygen_exporter_crx_encrypted_button.description: Primary button that copies the CRX signing key encrypted under the passphrase.

keygen_exporter_crx_plaintext_blurb.message: Plaintext export (raw PKCS#8 PEM). Anyone who reads your clipboard gets full control of this signing key.
keygen_exporter_crx_plaintext_blurb.description: Red warning above the type-to-confirm field when copying a CRX signing key unencrypted. 'PKCS#8 PEM' is a format name; keep.

keygen_exporter_crx_plaintext_button.description: Red button that copies the CRX signing key unencrypted.

keygen_passkey_default_user.description: Account name shown in the browser's passkey dialog when registering a passkey with no key owner name available.

keygen_passkey_imported_user.description: Account name shown in the browser's passkey dialog when protecting an imported key that has no user ID.

keygen_error_prf_unsupported_authenticat.message: Your authenticator doesn't support PRF. Try a different passkey or use a password instead.
keygen_error_prf_unsupported_authenticat.description: Error shown on the protection step when the passkey just registered cannot derive a key (no WebAuthn PRF). 'PRF' is a technical name; keep.

keygen_prf_unsupported_intro.message: PRF not supported by this authenticator.
keygen_prf_unsupported_intro.description: First sentence of the error when a passkey cannot derive a key. Followed, separated by spaces, by the platform hints keygen_prf_unsupported_mac / _windows / _chrome as applicable.

keygen_prf_unsupported_mac.description: Platform hint appended to keygen_prf_unsupported_intro on macOS.

keygen_prf_unsupported_windows.message: Windows Hello doesn't support PRF - use a security key (e.g. YubiKey).
keygen_prf_unsupported_windows.description: Platform hint appended to keygen_prf_unsupported_intro on Windows. Plain hyphen, not a dash.

keygen_prf_unsupported_chrome.message: Chrome profile passkeys may not support PRF - try Google Password Manager or an external key.
keygen_prf_unsupported_chrome.description: Hint appended to keygen_prf_unsupported_intro on desktop Chrome. Plain hyphen, not a dash.

keygen_export_summary.message: Downloads one $ext$ file (standard ASCII-armored OpenPGP): your $private_keys$ as $private_block$s and your $contacts$ as $public_block$s.
keygen_export_summary.description: Export step summary. $ext$ is the literal '.asc'; $private_keys$ is keygen_export_summary_private_keys ('2 unlocked private keys'); $contacts$ is keygen_export_summary_contacts ('3 contacts'); $private_block$ / $public_block$ are the literal armor headers 'PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK' / 'PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK' (rendered monospace; the trailing 's' after each pluralises it in English, drop or rephrase as your language needs).
